title: a-constraint-that-stopped-constraining-carries-a-ruling
intention: ONE PREDICATE over a declared constraint set: something that was constraining the system stopped constraining it, and no ruling sits in the same act. That single comparison covers a `why` that moved, a check that was disabled, a falsifier that was weakened, a threshold that was loosened, and a deterministic red that was suppressed. A ruling cited in the same commit (or landing in it) makes the weakening accountable and the check silent; its absence is the finding. This is the physics behind the prose rule Akien offered and CC accepted the same day, which lands in cairn/CLAUDE.md's 'Rules awaiting physics' in the same act and is a tracked debt from the moment it is written (Law 4). NOTE: this ticket covers face 1 of corrosion (constraint drift). Face 2 (work claimed done but incomplete) is a separate mechanism with a separate detector. The PRIMARY corrosion discriminator is friction (core principles), not provenance — provenance is the accountability axis. See ruling 2026-08-20-corrosion-is-friction-increase-and-optimization-candidates.
why:
AKIEN'S REASON, and it is a claim about CC's behaviour rather than about artifacts: 'presenting a deterministic result of an error will prompt you to fix it, not to plaster over it.' An LLM's opinion that something looks wrong invites negotiation, hedging, and a paragraph explaining why it is acceptable. A deterministic red offers nothing to negotiate with, so the only available move is repair.

But a rule with no exit produces its own defect. Sometimes the check IS wrong, and when the only two moves are plaster or paralysis, CC's measured reflex is plaster. So the rule Akien offered is framed as an ESCAPE ROUTE, verbatim: 'we can add a rule about not plastering over deterministic feedback without a ruling by me if you want. that gives you an escape route.' Requiring a ruling is what makes 'this check is wrong' a sayable thing rather than something smuggled into a rationalising paragraph.

THE LIVED SYMPTOM: a check goes red; CC writes three paragraphs explaining why this instance is different, environmental, pre-existing, or out of scope; the red is dispositioned into prose and the corpus keeps its green. Nobody is lied to and nothing is recorded as having changed, and the system has quietly lost a constraint. Law 9 already forbids the vocabulary of that move ('there is no triage authority — not environmental, not pre-existing, not out of scope'), which is prose, which is why this ticket exists.

WHY ONE PREDICATE AND NOT FOUR: the unification came from noticing that this rule is the corrosion discriminator one level up. Drift with a ruling behind it is the system learning; drift with no ruling is corrosion. Suppression with a ruling behind it is a corrected check; suppression with no ruling is plaster. Same discriminator, different object — so four checks would have been four implementations of one comparison, kept in step by hand.
traces_to: Ruling 2026-08-14-corrosion-is-drift-with-no-ruling-behind-it — the term, the discriminator, and the plaster rule Akien offered in the same exchange
Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy. The CLAUDE.md prose is the IOU; this is the physics that retires it.
Law 9 — 'there is no triage authority — not environmental, not pre-existing, not out of scope' is exactly this rule, stated as prose that a reader has to remember to apply
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; a red dispositioned into a paragraph is an unmeasured claim replacing a measured one
Law 10 — every recorded observation is measurement, and Akien is inside the measurable set, which is what makes 'are his own commits subject to this?' a real open question rather than an obvious no

falsifier.proves_green: PROVE GATE — the tester runs proofs with these teeth: a weakening with no cited ruling REDS; the same weakening with a ruling cited GREENS (the beneficial-drift tooth, the one a hollow build omits); a strengthening is untouched; a narrowing of the constraint set REDS via self-reference; each of the four constraint kinds is exercised by the SAME predicate; a stale unrelated ruling in decisions/ does NOT satisfy the citation. BUILD GATE — build_inspector at the PROVEME crossing. DURABILITY GATE — committed to both repos. KICKS BACK ON — red routes to build at the point of creation (CP2); a firing that turns out to be ordinary mid-build sharpening routes to the SCOPING question and NEVER to disabling the check — written here so it cannot be improvised under pressure.
falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) a constraint is weakened with no ruling cited and the check does not fire; (2) the check fires on a weakening that DOES cite a ruling — a ruled change is the system learning, and redding it is the freeze this design exists to avoid; (3) the constraint set is narrowed and the check does not fire on ITSELF; (4) the check is built to read only `why` fields, when the predicate is general and the why is one member; (5) 'a ruling in the same act' is implemented loosely enough that a pre-existing unrelated ruling satisfies it; (6) the check fires so often on ordinary mid-build sharpening that its output stops being read — measured as more than a third of firings dispositioned 'not really a weakening' over the first 30.
falsifier.horizon: Beside the other corrosion instruments. The prose rule lands in CLAUDE.md today and is a tracked debt from that moment; it should not outlive the instruments it sits beside. Not urgent ahead of the chart floor build order Akien set the same day (orient, then constrain, then survey), and explicitly behind `the-proof-record-persists-so-runs-can-be-compared`, which is the corrosion program's substrate.

how: One predicate over a declared constraint set: if something that was constraining stopped, and no ruling sits in the same act, it reds. Build as a build_inspector sieve over the constraint declarations (CLAUDE.md IOUs, charter gates, sieve bands).
